ContainedObjects.Description: Use the rim buttons from either side. A setup opening can be closed. After the first console activation, the buttons show the excavation record. Right-click the chamber to reset for a new game.
ContainedObjects.LuaScript:
local closedGuid="fc2b04"
local openGuid="fc2b08"
local ownerGuid="fc2b02"
local desired=nil
local pending=nil
local waiting=false
local painted=nil

local function gate()
    return getObjectFromGUID(openGuid) or getObjectFromGUID(closedGuid)
end

local function ownerCall(name,params)
    local owner=getObjectFromGUID(ownerGuid)
    if owner and not owner.spawning then return owner.call(name,params) end
end

local function ready()
    local piece=gate()
    return piece and not piece.spawning and (Global.getVar("hld") or 0)==0
end

local function paint()
    local action=desired and (ownerCall("fwHasActivations") and "record" or "close") or "open"
    if painted==action then return end
    local label=({open="Open doors",close="Close doors",record="View record"})[action]
    local hint=({open="Open all four chamber doors.",close="Close all four doors after a setup or test opening.",
        record="The ruin is open for this game. Show both sides' Excavation Console and Core records."})[action]
    for index,direction in ipairs({-1,1}) do
        if painted then
            self.editButton({index=index-1,label=label,tooltip=hint})
        else
            self.createButton({click_function="fwUseControl",function_owner=self,label=label,tooltip=hint,
                position={0,2.82,direction*3.85},rotation={0,direction==1 and 180 or 0,0},
                width=790,height=208,font_size=100,scale={.53,.53,.53},
                color={.12,.24,.23,.99},font_color={.95,1,.94,1}})
        end
    end
    painted=action
end

local function reconcile()
    if not ready() then return end
    local piece=gate()
    local actual=piece.getStateId()==2
    if pending~=nil then desired=pending
    elseif desired==nil then desired=actual or ownerCall("fwWantsOpenDoors")==true end
    if ownerCall("fwHasActivations")==true then desired=true end
    paint()
    if actual~=desired then
        pending=desired
        local target=desired and 2 or 1
        local result=piece.setState(target)
        if result then result.setLock(true) end
    else
        pending=nil
        ownerCall("fwDoorsChanged",{open=actual})
    end
end

local function whenReady()
    if waiting then return end
    waiting=true
    Wait.condition(function()
        waiting=false
        reconcile()
    end,ready,90,function() waiting=false end)
end

local function request(open)
    desired=open
    pending=open
    ownerCall("fwDoorsChanged",{open=open})
    paint()
    if ready() then reconcile() else whenReady() end
end

function fwOpenDoors(params)
    local changed=desired~=true
    request(true)
    if changed and params and params.announce then
        broadcastToAll("All four chamber doors are open.",{.66,.87,.83})
    end
    return true
end

function fwCloseDoors(params)
    if ownerCall("fwHasActivations")==true then
        if params and params.color then
            printToColor("A console has been activated. The doors stay open for this game. To start over, right-click the chamber and choose Reset excavation (new game).",params.color,{.78,.92,1})
        end
        return false
    end
    request(false)
    return true
end

function fwRecordMenu(color)
    ownerCall("fwStatus",{color=color})
end

function fwResetMenu(color)
    local player=Player[color]
    if not player then return end
    player.showConfirmDialog("Start a new excavation? This clears both sides' console and Core records and closes all four chamber doors.",
        function()
            ownerCall("fwResetExcavation")
            request(false)
        end)
end

function fwUseControl(object,color)
    if not desired then fwOpenDoors({color=color,announce=true})
    elseif ownerCall("fwHasActivations")==true then fwRecordMenu(color)
    else fwCloseDoors({color=color}) end
end

function fwMenuOpen(color) fwOpenDoors({color=color,announce=true}) end
function fwMenuClose(color) fwCloseDoors({color=color}) end

function onLoad(saved)
    if saved=="open" then desired=true elseif saved=="sealed" then desired=false end
    paint()
    self.addContextMenuItem("Open all four doors",fwMenuOpen,false)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Close doors (setup)",fwMenuClose,false)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Excavation record",fwRecordMenu,false)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Reset excavation (new game)",fwResetMenu,false)
    Wait.frames(whenReady,1)
end

function onObjectStateChange(new,oldGuid)
    if oldGuid~=closedGuid and oldGuid~=openGuid then return end
    local newGuid=new.getGUID()
    if newGuid~=closedGuid and newGuid~=openGuid then return end
    local isOpen=newGuid==openGuid
    if pending==nil or pending==isOpen then desired=isOpen;pending=nil end
    Wait.frames(whenReady,1)
end

function onObjectSpawn(piece)
    local id=piece.getGUID()
    if id==closedGuid or id==openGuid then Wait.frames(whenReady,1) end
end

function onSave()
    return desired and "open" or "sealed"
end

-- BEGIN LOBO BRIGHT ZONES R1
-- Coordinates and line widths are measured in tabletop inches.
local loboZonePalette={
 {name='Red',rgb={1,0,0},hex='#FF0000FF'},
 {name='Orange',rgb={1,.45,0},hex='#FF7300FF'},
 {name='Yellow',rgb={1,1,0},hex='#FFFF00FF'},
 {name='Green',rgb={0,1,0},hex='#00FF00FF'},
 {name='Blue',rgb={.10,.35,1},hex='#1A59FFFF'},
 {name='Indigo',rgb={.50,.20,1},hex='#8033FFFF'},
 {name='Violet',rgb={.90,.08,1},hex='#E614FFFF'}
}
local function loboZoneIndex(n,default)
 return type(n)=='number' and n==math.floor(n) and n>=1 and n<=7 and n or default
end
local function loboZoneVector(p)return Vector(p.x or p[1],p.y or p[2],p.z or p[3])end
local function loboInk(target,out,points,kind)
 if not target or target.isDestroyed() or #points<2 then return end
 kind=kind or 'deployment'
 local scale=target.getScale();local width=math.max(math.abs(scale.x),math.abs(scale.z),.000001)
 local function stroke(path)
  out[#out+1]={points=path,color={.015,.015,.015},thickness=.15/width,loboZoneKind=kind,loboZoneEdge=true}
  out[#out+1]={points=path,color={1,0,0},thickness=.10/width,loboZoneKind=kind,loboZoneEdge=false}
 end
 if kind~='exclusion' then stroke(points);return end
 local step,length=.50,.12
 local nextDot,distance=step*.5,0
 for i=2,#points do
  local a,b=loboZoneVector(points[i-1]),loboZoneVector(points[i])
  local aw,bw=target.positionToWorld(a),target.positionToWorld(b)
  local span=math.sqrt((bw.x-aw.x)^2+(bw.z-aw.z)^2)
  while span>0 and nextDot<=distance+span do
   local t0=math.max(0,(nextDot-distance-length/2)/span)
   local t1=math.min(1,(nextDot-distance+length/2)/span)
   stroke({{a.x+(b.x-a.x)*t0,a.y+(b.y-a.y)*t0,a.z+(b.z-a.z)*t0},
           {a.x+(b.x-a.x)*t1,a.y+(b.y-a.y)*t1,a.z+(b.z-a.z)*t1}})
   nextDot=nextDot+step
  end
  distance=distance+span
 end
end
-- One generation per MAT, shared by every contributing script. Late jobs cannot
-- restore old guides after Off, another selection, a clear, or a color change.
local function loboZoneWrite(target,source)
 if not target or target.isDestroyed() then return end
 local combined={}
 for _,line in ipairs(source or {})do if not line.loboStandardGuide then combined[#combined+1]=line end end
 for _,line in ipairs(target.getTable('LoboStandardGuides')or{})do combined[#combined+1]=line end
 source=combined
 target.setTable('LoboZoneSourceR1',source or {})
 local generation=(target.getVar('LoboZoneGenerationR1') or 0)+1
 target.setVar('LoboZoneGenerationR1',generation)
 local colors=target.getTable('LoboZoneColorsR1') or {}
 local result,tasks,cache={},{},{}
 local bounds=target.getBounds()
 local floor=bounds.center.y+bounds.size.y/2
 local tags={};for _,tag in ipairs(target.getTags() or {})do if tag:sub(1,8)=='LoboMap:' then tags[tag]=true end end
 local function terrain(o)
  if not o or o.isDestroyed() then return false end
  if o==target then return true end
  if o.hasTag('mission') or o.hasTag('controller') or o.hasTag('LoboBackgroundController') then return false end
  for tag in pairs(tags)do if o.hasTag(tag) then return true end end
  return false
 end
 for _,line in ipairs(source or {})do
  local kind=line.loboZoneKind
  if not kind then result[#result+1]=line
  else
   local rgb=kind=='scoring' and {.92,.94,1} or loboZonePalette[loboZoneIndex(colors[kind],kind=='exclusion' and 3 or 1)].rgb
   local path={}
   local copy={points=path,color=line.loboZoneEdge and {.015,.015,.015} or rgb,thickness=line.thickness}
   result[#result+1]=copy
   local function point(w)
    local key=string.format('%.5f:%.5f',w.x,w.z)
    local entry=cache[key]
    if not entry then entry={world=w,points={}};cache[key]=entry;tasks[#tasks+1]=entry end
    local p={0,0,0};path[#path+1]=p
    local lift=line.loboZoneEdge and .035 or .042
    if kind=='exclusion' then lift=lift+.009 end
    entry.points[#entry.points+1]={p=p,lift=lift}
   end
   local previous=nil
   for _,p in ipairs(line.points or {})do
    local w=target.positionToWorld(loboZoneVector(p))
    if previous then
     local distance=math.sqrt((w.x-previous.x)^2+(w.z-previous.z)^2)
     local count=math.max(1,math.ceil(distance/.5))
     for j=1,count do local t=j/count;point(Vector(previous.x+(w.x-previous.x)*t,0,previous.z+(w.z-previous.z)*t))end
    else point(w)end
    previous=w
   end
  end
 end
 local index=1
 local function step()
  if self.isDestroyed() or target.isDestroyed() or target.getVar('LoboZoneGenerationR1')~=generation then return end
  for work=1,8 do
   local item=tasks[index]
   if not item then target.setVectorLines(result);return end
   local w=item.world;local y=floor
   if Physics and Physics.cast then
    local ok,hits=pcall(Physics.cast,{origin={w.x,math.max(50,floor+40),w.z},direction={0,-1,0},type=1,max_distance=100})
    if ok then for _,hit in ipairs(hits or {})do
     if hit.point and terrain(hit.hit_object) then y=math.max(y,hit.point.y)end
    end end
   end
   for _,ref in ipairs(item.points)do
    local p=target.positionToLocal(Vector(w.x,y+ref.lift,w.z))
    ref.p[1],ref.p[2],ref.p[3]=p.x,p.y,p.z
   end
   index=index+1
  end
  Wait.frames(step,1)
 end
 if #tasks==0 then target.setVectorLines(result)else Wait.frames(step,1)end
end
-- END LOBO BRIGHT ZONES R1

 return hits
end
function lmr.data(d)
 if not lmr.flipped()then return d end
 local t=d.Transform
 if t then t.posX=-(t.posX or 0);t.posZ=-(t.posZ or 0);t.rotY=((t.rotY or 0)+180)%360 end
 for _,s in pairs(d.States or{})do lmr.data(s)end
 return d
end
function lmr.getData(o) return lmr.data(o.getData()) end
function lmr.getJSON(o,...) return JSON.encode(lmr.data(JSON.decode(o.getJSON(...)))) end
function lmr.spawnObjectJSON(p)
 local q=lmr.copy(p);q.json=JSON.encode(lmr.data(JSON.decode(q.json)))
 if q.position then q.position=lmr.point(q.position)end
 if q.rotation then q.rotation=lmr.rotation(q.rotation)end
 return spawnObjectJSON(q)
end
function lmr.spawnObjectData(p)
 local q=lmr.copy(p);q.data=lmr.data(q.data)
 if q.position then q.position=lmr.point(q.position)end
 if q.rotation then q.rotation=lmr.rotation(q.rotation)end
 return spawnObjectData(q)
end
function lmr.spawnObject(p)
 local q=lmr.copy(p)
 if q.position then q.position=lmr.point(q.position)end
 if q.rotation then q.rotation=lmr.rotation(q.rotation)end
 return spawnObject(q)
end
